summary: Haleon plc filed a Form 6-K reporting open-market share repurchases under its buyback program announced on 12 March 2026. Over five trading days (11–15 May 2026), the company bought 8,316,688 ordinary shares at volume-weighted average prices ranging from 327.7p to 330.9p per share, all for cancellation. Post-settlement, registered share capital is 8,871,945,578 shares, with 12,130,560 held in treasury, leaving 8,859,815,018 voting shares. This is an issuer share buyback that returns capital to shareholders. There is no control premium, advisor, or structural complexity; the program is ongoing. Investors should watch for continued execution pace and potential impact on EPS and free float.
